show.description: A fallen racing champion loses everything after his adopted brother betrays him, rigs a race, kills their parents, and steals his crown. Years later, he returns in disguise as a humble mechanic and joins a struggling racing club. Forced back onto the track, he must face his past, defeat his betrayer, and reclaim his destiny.
